card.name: Words leading up to 'prepared'
card.fires_on: Small linking words or adverbs such as 'be', 'freshly', 'after', 'of' and 'in' right before an expected form of 'prepare' or 'preparation'. It appears in mixing and reconstitution instructions for injections and suspensions.

modes.label: Passive before prepared
modes.description: 'be' or 'freshly' after must, should or a solution, just before 'prepared'.

modes.label: Timing before preparation
modes.description: 'after', 'of' or 'in' in time limits or technique statements that end in 'preparation' or 'mixing'.
modes.example: Use the MACRILEN solution within 30 minutes<< after>> preparation.

card.writes: It boosts forms of 'prepare' and 'preparation' as the next word.
